name: Test: XNA math in C# against the game (C#)
author: test
summary: Every XNA math member Bunny Loader writes in C# (Vector2/3/4, Matrix, Quaternion, Plane, MathHelper, Rectangle, Color) against the game's own version (Name_), on random inputs and edge cases.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csxnamath. In the world, logs 'csxnamath <type>.<member>: ok | FAIL <input> ours <x> game <y>' and 'csxnamath END pass=N fail=M'.
